import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    t = int(data[0])
    N = 200000
    s = bytearray([1]) * (N + 1)
    s[0] = s[1] = 0
    for i in range(2, int(N ** 0.5) + 1):
        if s[i]:
            s[i * i::i] = bytearray(len(range(i * i, N + 1, i)))
    cnt = [0] * (N + 1)
    last = [-1] * (N + 1)
    c = 0
    l = -1
    for i in range(N + 1):
        if s[i]:
            c += 1
            l = i
        cnt[i] = c
        last[i] = l
    out = []
    for x in data[1:1 + t]:
        n = int(x)
        out.append("%d %s" % (cnt[n], last[n] if last[n] >= 0 else "none"))
    print("\n".join(out))

main()
